pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-03.png with Read and looked at it. The page has five panels in three rows: two in the top row, two in the middle row and one wide panel at the bottom. Read left to right, top to bottom. (1) Top-left panel: caption at upper left: "A later morning: patients can always check in at the front desk." Grey placeholder boxes labelled 'raman' (left) and 'meera' (right), with no speech. (2) Top-right panel: caption at upper left: "Some check in ahead on the Welbuk Health app." One placeholder labelled 'priya', no speech. (3) Middle-left panel: caption at upper left: "Ravi scans the QR code at the door." Placeholder labelled 'ravi' to the right of the caption, no speech. (4) Middle-right panel: caption at upper left: "A short form on his own phone, shared with consent." A tall placeholder labelled 'ravi' at the right edge, no speech. (5) Bottom wide panel: caption at upper left: "Every check-in gets a slot on the screen.", then a teal rounded label at upper right: "A-10 · A-11 · A-12". Placeholders labelled 'raman', 'priya' and 'ravi' from left to right, all silent. The page has no speech balloons. All text is narration captions plus one screen label. Page number '3' is at the bottom.
pages.observation: The reading order is clear: a simple Z path through 2+2+1 panels, with one caption per panel at the top-left entry point. The bottom-right screen label is read last. The page has no dialogue, so no reply can be skipped and no balloons sit close enough to cause confusion. All text is legible. The text stays inside the caption boxes and does not touch the box borders. The caption boxes sit very close to the panel frames: in the top row the box top is only about 4 px below the panel top. The boxes do not cross the frames. The time-skip caption "A later morning:" clearly opens the scene. Ravi is named in panel 3 before panel 4 says "his own phone", so 'his' has a clear referent. None of the captions overlap the placeholder face boxes. In panel 3 the placeholder sits close to the right of the caption, and the placeholders in panels 1 and 2 are just below the captions, so the final art must keep heads clear of the caption bottoms. In panel 5 the 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' label is a separate teal box. Without art it reads as a stand-alone label, not clearly as on-screen text, so the art must place it inside a visible screen. Minor: the monospace caption font gives "Ravi scans" a slightly wide gap. No unresolved reading-order problems at storyboard level.
